title: Bondi Beach With Kids: A Family Guide
metaDescription: Bondi Beach with kids, from local parents — the calmest swimming, the best playgrounds, family-friendly cafés, and where to find toilets, showers and change rooms.
intro: Bondi is a brilliant beach for families once you know where to go. Here's where we take our own kids — the calmest water up the north end, the best playgrounds, the cafés that actually welcome a pram, and where to find the toilets, showers and change rooms when you need them.

sections.heading: Where to swim with children
sections.intro: The northern end is the calmest, safest water for little ones — the sheltered North Bondi children's pool and the area between the red-and-yellow flags. The southern end has the rips, so keep the kids up north.
